description: Read shops, warehouses, goods, inventory, orders, stockouts, and refunds from Wangdian ERP.

fields.label: SID
fields.description: The seller account assigned when purchasing Wangdian ERP. View it with your production application credentials or ask the ERP purchaser: https://open.wangdian.cn/open/guide?path=guide_jkgf

fields.label: AppKey
fields.description: The production application AppKey created under Self-service Integration > Application Management in the Wangdian Open Platform: https://open.wangdian.cn/open/guide?path=guide_kfzn

fields.label: AppSecret
fields.description: The production AppSecret paired with the AppKey in Wangdian Open Platform Application Management. It is used only to sign requests and is never sent to Wangdian: https://open.wangdian.cn/open/guide?path=guide_signsf

actions.name: list_goods
actions.description: List goods and SKU records from Wangdian ERP Enterprise Edition.

specNo.description: The merchant SKU code to retrieve.

goodsNo.description: The product or SPU code to retrieve.

brandNo.description: The brand code used to filter goods.

className.description: The goods category name used to filter results.

barcode.description: The barcode used to filter goods.

startTime.description: A China Standard Time timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

endTime.description: A China Standard Time timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

includeDeleted.description: Whether to include deleted goods records.

pageNo.description: The zero-based page number. Defaults to 0.

pageSize.description: The number of records to return, from 1 to 100.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Wangdian ERP goods records.

items.description: One goods record returned by Wangdian, including its nested SKU list when available.

goods.description: One goods record returned by Wangdian, including its nested SKU list when available.

anyOf.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

totalCount.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

actions.name: list_inventory
actions.description: List physical stock and inventory allocation records from Wangdian ERP.

warehouseNo.description: The warehouse code used to filter inventory.

specNo.description: The merchant SKU code used to retrieve inventory.

barcode.description: The barcode used to retrieve inventory.

startTime.description: A China Standard Time timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

endTime.description: A China Standard Time timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

onlyExistingInventory.description: Whether to return only inventory records that are not deleted in inventory management.

includeDeletedGoods.description: Whether to include inventory for deleted goods records.

pageNo.description: The zero-based page number. Defaults to 0.

pageSize.description: The number of records to return, from 1 to 100.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Wangdian ERP inventory records.

items.description: One warehouse and SKU inventory record returned by Wangdian.

inventory.description: One warehouse and SKU inventory record returned by Wangdian.

anyOf.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

totalCount.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

actions.name: list_orders
actions.description: List sales orders from Wangdian ERP Enterprise Edition.

tradeNo.description: The Wangdian ERP sales order number to retrieve.

sourceTradeNo.description: The original platform order number to retrieve.

logisticsNo.description: The outbound logistics number to retrieve.

status.description: The Wangdian sales order status code used to filter results.

startTime.description: A China Standard Time timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

endTime.description: A China Standard Time timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

shopNo.description: The shop code used to filter sales orders.

shopNos.description: The shop codes used to filter records, with at most 20 shops per request.

warehouseNo.description: The warehouse code used to filter sales orders.

logisticsState.description: The logistics-number filter: 0 for any, 1 for present, or 2 for absent.

fuzzySourceTradeNo.description: Whether to use a fuzzy match when querying by sourceTradeNo.

includePaymentDetails.description: Whether to include payment transaction details in returned orders.

calculateTaxBySku.description: Whether Wangdian should calculate tax by individual SKU.

pageNo.description: The zero-based page number. Defaults to 0.

pageSize.description: The number of records to return, from 1 to 100.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Wangdian ERP sales orders.

items.description: One sales order record returned by Wangdian.

orders.description: One sales order record returned by Wangdian.

anyOf.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

totalCount.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

outputSchema.description: A paginated Wangdian sales order result.

actions.name: list_refunds
actions.description: List refund and exchange records from Wangdian ERP Enterprise Edition.

refundNo.description: The Wangdian ERP refund number to retrieve.

sourceRefundNo.description: The original platform refund number to retrieve.

tradeNo.description: The Wangdian ERP sales order number to retrieve refunds for.

sourceTradeNo.description: The original platform order number to retrieve refunds for.

processStatus.description: The Wangdian refund processing status code used to filter results.

timeType.description: The time field to query: 0 for modified, 1 for settlement, or 2 for creation time.

startTime.description: A China Standard Time timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

endTime.description: A China Standard Time timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

shopNo.description: The shop code used to filter refunds.

shopNos.description: The shop codes used to filter records, with at most 20 shops per request.

returnLogisticsNo.description: The return logistics number used to filter refunds.

pageNo.description: The zero-based page number. Defaults to 0.

pageSize.description: The number of refund records to return, from 1 to 40.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Wangdian ERP refund and exchange records.

items.description: One refund or exchange record returned by Wangdian.

refunds.description: One refund or exchange record returned by Wangdian.

anyOf.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

totalCount.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

actions.name: list_sales_stockouts
actions.description: List sales stockout records from Wangdian ERP Enterprise Edition.

stockoutNo.description: The Wangdian sales stockout number to retrieve.

tradeNo.description: The Wangdian ERP sales order number to retrieve.

sourceTradeNo.description: The original platform order number to retrieve.

status.description: The Wangdian sales stockout status code used to filter results.

startTime.description: A China Standard Time timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

endTime.description: A China Standard Time timestamp in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

shopNo.description: The shop code used to filter sales stockouts.

shopNos.description: The shop codes used to filter records, with at most 20 shops per request.

warehouseNo.description: The warehouse code used to filter sales stockouts.

queryByModified.description: Whether the time range should use last-modified time instead of consign time.

includePositionDetails.description: Whether to include warehouse position details in returned stockout records.

stockOnly.description: Whether to return only stock-related data.

pageNo.description: The zero-based page number. Defaults to 0.

pageSize.description: The number of records to return, from 1 to 100.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Wangdian ERP sales stockout records.

items.description: One sales stockout record returned by Wangdian.

stockouts.description: One sales stockout record returned by Wangdian.

anyOf.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

totalCount.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

outputSchema.description: A paginated Wangdian sales stockout result.

actions.name: list_shops
actions.description: List shop records configured in Wangdian ERP Enterprise Edition.

platformId.description: The Wangdian platform ID used to filter shops.

platformIds.description: The Wangdian platform IDs used to filter shops.

disabled.description: Whether to return disabled shops. Omit this field to return enabled shops.

pageNo.description: The zero-based page number. Defaults to 0.

pageSize.description: The number of records to return, from 1 to 100.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Wangdian ERP shops.

items.description: One shop record returned by Wangdian.

shops.description: One shop record returned by Wangdian.

anyOf.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

totalCount.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.

actions.name: list_warehouses
actions.description: List warehouse records configured in Wangdian ERP Enterprise Edition.

warehouseType.description: The Wangdian warehouse type code used to filter results.

subType.description: The subtype used for warehouses whose type is Other.

disabled.description: Whether to return disabled warehouses. Omit this field to return enabled warehouses.

pageNo.description: The zero-based page number. Defaults to 0.

pageSize.description: The number of records to return, from 1 to 100.

items.description: One warehouse record returned by Wangdian.

warehouses.description: One warehouse record returned by Wangdian.

totalCount.description: The total number of matching records, or null when Wangdian omits it after page 0.
